columns.name: berth
columns.reason: Berth assignment is part of arrival planning and is fixed before any damage inspection.

columns.name: paint_spec
columns.reason: Static build attribute of the container, fixed at manufacture.

columns.name: iso_type_code
columns.reason: Permanent ISO equipment type designation of the unit.

columns.name: chassis_type
columns.reason: Haulage equipment attribute known when the move is arranged.

columns.name: repair_shop
columns.reason: A repair shop is only assigned once damage has been found, so it encodes the outcome.

columns.name: reefer_flag
columns.reason: Static equipment characteristic of the container.

columns.name: haulier
columns.reason: Trucking company is fixed at booking/dispatch, before arrival inspection.

columns.name: stack_position
columns.reason: Stowage slot comes from the vessel stowage plan set before discharge.

columns.name: depot_code
columns.reason: Depot identity is routing/handling context known ahead of inspection.

columns.name: booking_office
columns.reason: Recorded at booking, long before the container arrives.

columns.name: recert_month
columns.reason: Scheduled CSC recertification date is a standing attribute of the unit.

columns.name: voyage_legs
columns.reason: Number of legs comes from the planned routing, complete by the time of arrival.

columns.name: weighbridge_id
columns.reason: Weighing infrastructure used during gate handling, independent of the damage finding.

columns.name: offhire_days
columns.reason: Name does not distinguish lifetime off-hire history from the off-hire spell caused by this damage event.

columns.name: port_pair
columns.reason: Origin/destination pair is set at booking.

columns.name: lessor
columns.reason: Ownership/lease party is a standing attribute of the container.

columns.name: prior_damage_history_index
columns.reason: Explicitly prior history, complete before this shipment; predictive but not outcome-derived.

columns.name: survey_structural_damage_code
columns.reason: Arrival survey finding that is itself an input to deciding whether the unit was damaged.

columns.name: days_to_release
columns.reason: Measured after arrival and only final once the unit is released, past the prediction point.

columns.name: seal_type
columns.reason: Seal is applied at stuffing, well before arrival.

columns.name: ocr_camera_set
columns.reason: Gate camera infrastructure used for handling, not derived from the damage verdict.

columns.name: manufacture_yard
columns.reason: Where the box was built; fixed permanently at manufacture.

columns.name: gate_lane
columns.reason: Operational lane used at the gate, set during handling and not outcome-derived.

columns.name: customs_regime
columns.reason: Declared regime for the shipment, established with the documentation.

columns.name: crane_id
columns.reason: Discharge crane is recorded during handling, before the damage survey.

columns.name: imo_class
columns.reason: Hazard classification of the cargo, declared at booking.

columns.name: trade_lane
columns.reason: Service geography fixed at booking.

columns.name: lashing_spec
columns.reason: Securing specification applied at loading, before the voyage.

columns.name: photo_batch
columns.reason: Photo batch identifier is generated by the arrival damage inspection that sets the target.

columns.name: survey_watertight_fail_code
columns.reason: Survey test result used to determine the damage outcome.

columns.name: cargo_weight_t
columns.reason: Weight is captured at gate-in/weighing before the arrival inspection.

columns.name: inspection_shift
columns.reason: Scheduling context of the inspection, known when it is arranged and not derived from its result.

columns.name: depot_resurvey_grade
columns.reason: A resurvey grade is assigned after the initial arrival assessment and reflects the damage verdict.

columns.name: repair_estimate_usd
columns.reason: Costing only exists once damage has been identified and quantified.

columns.name: container_age_years
columns.reason: Derived from build date, known at any prediction point.

columns.name: vessel_class
columns.reason: Attribute of the carrying vessel, known before arrival.

columns.name: surveyor_firm
columns.reason: Identifies the firm engaged for the arrival damage survey, known only once that outcome-setting survey occurs.

columns.name: terminal
columns.reason: Discharge terminal is fixed by the routing before arrival.

columns.name: service_string
columns.reason: Liner service loop assigned at booking.

columns.name: cscs_plate_class
columns.reason: Safety approval plate classification is a standing attribute of the unit.

columns.name: owner_prefix
columns.reason: BIC owner prefix is permanently assigned to the container.
